user.title: Add a key slot
user.description: Pick a Z-Wave lock and the user-code slot this device should manage. Add the integration again for every further slot — several slots on the same lock are fine.

data_description.slot: The user-code slot on the lock (1 – {max_slot}). Whatever is currently programmed in it is taken over.
data_description.name: Defaults to "<lock name> slot <number>".

error.not_zwave_lock: This lock is not provided by the Z-Wave integration.
error.no_user_codes: This lock does not expose any user-code slots.
error.lock_unavailable: The lock's Z-Wave node can't be reached. Is the Z-Wave integration running?

abort.already_configured: This slot on this lock is already managed.

invalid_code.message: The code must be 4 – 10 digits, or empty to remove it.

invalid_window.message: "Active to" must be later than "Active from".

unknown_device.message: Device {device_id} is not a Key Slot Master slot.

set_slot.name: Set key slot
set_slot.description: Change one or more properties of key slots in a single call. Omitted fields stay as they are.

device_id.name: Key slot
device_id.description: The key slot device(s) to change.

code.name: Code
code.description: 4 – 10 digit PIN. Empty or null removes the code.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the slot may grant access.

active_from.name: Active from
active_from.description: Start of the active window. Null removes the bound.

active_to.name: Active to
active_to.description: End of the active window. Null removes the bound.
